import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static int[][] cap;
    static char[][] sci, rec;
    static int[][][][] dist;
    static int[] dx = {1,0,-1,0};
    static int[] dy = {0,1,0,-1};
    static int[][] seenA, seenB;
    static int[] level, ptr;

    static int getnode(int x, int y) {
        return x * n + y;
    }

    static void spread(int val) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                seenB[i][j] = seenA[i][j];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (seenB[i][j] == val) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                        int ni = i + dx[k], nj = j + dy[k];
                        if (ni >= 0 && nj >= 0 && ni < n && nj < n && seenB[ni][nj] < val && sci[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                            seenA[ni][nj] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean reachable(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int ix, int iy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(seenA[i], 0);
        seenA[sx][sy] = 1;
        seenA[ix][iy] = 2;
        for (int step = 0; step < 100; step++) {
            spread(1);
            if (seenA[tx][ty] == 1) return true;
            spread(2);
            if (seenA[tx][ty] == 2) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static boolean make_level_graph(int src, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[src] = 0;
        q.add(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v = 0; v <= sink; v++) {
                if (level[v] == -1 && cap[u][v] > 0) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int dinic_dfs(int u, int sink, int pushed) {
        if (u == sink) return pushed;
        for (int v = ptr[u]; v <= sink; v++) {
            if (cap[u][v] > 0 && level[v] == level[u] + 1) {
                int got = dinic_dfs(v, sink, Math.min(pushed, cap[u][v]));
                if (got > 0) {
                    cap[u][v] -= got;
                    cap[v][u] += got;
                    return got;
                }
            }
            ptr[u] = v + 1; // update pointer
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        sci = new char[n][n];
        rec = new char[n][n];
        int infx = -1, infy = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                sci[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (sci[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    infx = i;
                    infy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                rec[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        // Initialize dist with large value
        dist = new int[n][n][n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++)
                    Arrays.fill(dist[i][j][k], 1000000000);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                dist[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int ni = i + dx[k], nj = j + dy[k];
                    if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && sci[i][j] != 'Y' && sci[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                        dist[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Floyd-Warshall
        for (int kx = 0; kx < n; kx++)
            for (int ky = 0; ky < n; ky++)
                for (int sx = 0; sx < n; sx++)
                    for (int sy = 0; sy < n; sy++)
                        for (int tx = 0; tx < n; tx++)
                            for (int ty = 0; ty < n; ty++)
                                dist[sx][sy][tx][ty] = Math.min(dist[sx][sy][tx][ty],
                                        dist[sx][sy][kx][ky] + dist[kx][ky][tx][ty]);

        int totalCells = n * n;
        int src = 2 * totalCells + 1;
        int sink = 2 * totalCells + 2;
        cap = new int[sink + 1][sink + 1];
        seenA = new int[n][n];
        seenB = new int[n][n];
        level = new int[sink + 1];
        ptr = new int[sink + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(sci[i][j])) {
                    cap[src][getnode(i, j)] = sci[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(rec[i][j])) {
                    cap[totalCells + getnode(i, j)][sink] = rec[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(sci[i][j]) && sci[i][j] > '0') {
                    for (int a = 0; a < n; a++) {
                        for (int b = 0; b < n; b++) {
                            if (Character.isDigit(rec[a][b]) && rec[a][b] > '0' &&
                                dist[i][j][a][b] <= t && reachable(i, j, a, b, infx, infy)) {
                                cap[getnode(i, j)][totalCells + getnode(a, b)] = 1000;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int answer = 0;
        while (make_level_graph(src, sink)) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int f;
            while ((f = dinic_dfs(src, sink, 1000000000)) > 0) {
                answer += f;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
